chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام about a man who performs sajdah upon a coarse cloth and a carpet, so he said:
There is no harm if it is in a state of taqiyyah, and there is no harm in performing sajdah upon clothes in a state of taqiyyah.

key_terms.التَّقِيَّةِ: taqiyyah; precautionary dissimulation in circumstances of risk or danger
key_terms.الثِّيَابِ: clothes or garments used here as a surface for prostration
key_terms.السُّجُودِ: sajdah; the act of prostration in salat
key_terms.الْمِسْحِ: a coarse cloth or fabric spread

ai.seo_question: Is sajdah on clothes or carpets permissible during taqiyyah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning sajdah on materials such as cloth or carpet when one is in a condition of taqiyyah. It indicates permissibility in such circumstances, showing that outward practice may be adjusted when dissimulation is required for protection.
